data.description:
# Dang right you can pet that dog! Get it some boops and some pats too! #

Studies show that petting a dog releases natural chemicals to relieve stress and reduce depression and boost health!!

We want you to be able to relax and enjoy your time, so there are no quests, rules or time limits here. You can pet, pat or boop your little companion as much as your heart desires!

There is also a record player that allows you to play some classical music to add to your relaxation.

There are also now Meta achievements to collect and compare with your friends!!

**Update #1 - Records:**
+ New default songs, 15 total.
+ New Unlockable Records, 23 total.
+ 2 New Achievements for unlocking records.

**Update #2 - Treats:**
+ NEW interactive Treat Vending Machine.
+ 6 different treats to feed to your doggo.
+ Added 7 new Treat feeding achievements.

**Coming Soon:**
- More Dogs

**Future Plans:**
- More locations to enjoy
- A HUGE selection of animals to add to your pet collection!!
